    for node in list(tree.body):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) and node.value.func.id == "exec" and isinstance(node.value.args[0], ast.Constant):
            tree.body.extend(ast.parse(node.value.args[0].value).body)
    cls = next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "Order")
